eas.description: Aliyun PAI-EAS OpenAI endpoint. Set EAS_API_* in .env; extra_body may stay here or use EAS_EXTRA_BODY JSON in .env.

bailian.description: Aliyun Bailian Responses API (OpenAI-compatible). Set DASHSCOPE_API_* in .env.

doubao.description: Doubao Realtime Voice API. Prefer DOUBAO_* / ASR_* in .env (see .env.example).

vad.description: VAD provider: smart_turn_v3 (default) or duplug. Env: VAD_PROVIDER, SMART_TURN_*.

debug._comment: t2s debug and VAD endpointing tuning (all timings in ms/sec as noted).
debug.t2s_pre_roll_ms_comment: Pre-roll audio kept before first nonidle to avoid clipping initial phonemes.
debug.t2s_speak_grace_ms_comment: After VAD speak, wait this grace window before finalize; canceled if nonidle returns.
debug.t2s_min_speech_ms_comment: Minimum effective speech duration before allowing turn completion.
debug.t2s_min_turn_gap_ms_comment: Minimum interval between two completed turns to prevent rapid re-trigger.
